name: gpt-oss-120b-3gpu
_comment: gpt-oss-120b MXFP4 across all three R9700s. HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2 is the three discrete cards (index 3 is the iGPU and must stay out -- indices shifted after the 3rd card was installed, confirmed live via amd-smi list on 2026-09-29). NCCL_PROTO/NCCL_P2P_DISABLE are NOT needed and do nothing on this build (GGML_HIP_RCCL=OFF, confirmed in TECHNIKA.md 9.x) -- removed. --load-mode dio is REQUIRED: without it, model load hangs indefinitely (VRAM fills, then GPU activity stays at 3-5% forever) due to a known ROCm HSA userptr-registration bug in the default mmap load path with large (>~50GB) models -- see llama.cpp issue #19482, confirmed by multiple users including a 4xR9700 report. This is NOT a VRAM/capacity issue -- TECHNIKA.md 10.3's original 'this model needs a third card' conclusion was wrong; the 2-card hang had the same root cause and would likely also be fixed by --load-mode dio. Rebuilt llama.cpp from 987498f (Sep 15) to 680a036 (Sep 28) during this investigation; the rebuild alone did NOT fix the hang, --load-mode dio did.
